answer: A pearl of bonded collateral prices identity here. Each juror locks stake, and every ballot escrows a slice against slashing: diverge from the panel median by one step and it burns. A farm splitting into a thousand keys must post a thousand bonds, yet grading income per key is capped by seat allotment, so capital at risk climbs with headcount while expected return does not. Duplicate submissions hash identically and collapse to one paid slot. Under the ember surface: quartz collateral sets the price of a voice, so singletons stay solvent, farms bleed.
